bots.title: Rosettabot
bots.description: Paste a foreign-language Grok Bot Add link; it fetches the card and tells you what that bot actually does — any language, English by default.

bots.title: Rogue Hunter Bot
bots.description: Police for a Grok Bot fleet: cuts the bill, hunts copycat bots, and occupies the niche. Defensive only, with weekly recaps and a hunt when a new bot appears.

bots.title: RewardsMaxxing Bot
bots.description: Reads your Link wallet, shows what each card earns, locks a playbook, and pays on the highest-earn path.

bots.title: RevenueDog Bot
bots.description: Morning sales analyst for indie subscription apps: RevenueCat numbers plus conversion path from Analytics.

bots.title: Revenue Signal Radar Bot
bots.description: Weekday revenue-action radar for HubSpot shops. Ranks expansion, stalled deals, and closed-lost revival with evidence and draft next steps. Read-only until you approve an exact send.

bots.title: Revenue Enablement Bot
bots.description: Routes sales and RevOps asks to the right specialist skill, then returns reviewable drafts for messaging, coaching, launches, programs, measurement, and account work.

bots.title: Retrieval Exam Bot
bots.description: Closes the book and tests what you can actually reconstruct.

bots.title: Researchy Bot
bots.description: Research and fact-check desk that runs every pass on the latest Grok model with live web search via Grok Build CLI.

bots.title: Researcher Bot
bots.description: Sourced research agent: breaks asks into sub-questions, keeps only direct answers, cites every claim, flags contradictions, and states gaps.

bots.title: Repo Engineer Bot
bots.description: Ships small GitHub fixes as pull requests through Cursor cloud agents. Manager-facing engineer bot that never merges and never checks the repo out locally.

bots.title: Replydebt Bot
bots.description: Ends the unread-text shame spiral: triages ghosted threads, drafts a 1–2 line honest reopen. Never sends without your yes.

bots.title: Rentals Bot
bots.description: Facebook Marketplace rental listing manager for owners. Watches listings, engages leads in your voice, books showings.

bots.title: Redact Bot
bots.description: Submits people-search and data-broker opt-out requests so you stop paying for removal services.

bots.title: Recent Bookmarks Search Bot
bots.description: Search and sort your recent X bookmarks in a local table viewer. Connect X, pull the newest 100, open details, and load more when you have API credits.

bots.title: Receipt Bot
bots.description: Forward or photo receipts to a dedicated inbox. Builds a Drive spreadsheet with links, split by month and year.

bots.title: Realtor Bot
bots.description: House-hunting aide for buyers and renters: public portals, shortlists, new listings and price drops. Not a licensed agent.

bots.title: Raven Bot
bots.description: Goth-mommy nutrition coach. Log meals (text or a photo), get kcal + protein estimates, and a running day total vs your goals — short, sharp, judgmental-with-care. Not medical advice.

bots.title: Ratio Bot
bots.description: Pre-flight desk for public language: forecasts how a draft will get quote-tweeted and returns a sharper version that keeps the point.

bots.title: Ramp Bot
bots.description: Finds remote-meal receipts in work email and attaches them to matching expense transactions after you approve.

bots.title: Radar Bot
bots.description: Local public-feed watcher for your city and county. Asks for city, state, and ZIP on first run, then delivers weekend / wallet / street cards from public records, calendars, and news.

bots.title: Proto Bot
bots.description: UI/UX design engineer who ships three deeply different directions per concept as real, polished prototypes. Crafts requirements and testable hypotheses.

bots.title: Prospectacle Bot
bots.description: Finds prospects that match your ICP, researches each on the public web, and drafts a first-touch message — never invents facts.

bots.title: Promo Copy Bot
bots.description: Writes social product-promo copy ready to paste and post. Cuts AI flavor, keeps it chatty, and retunes the angle from read counts.

bots.title: Producthunter Bot
bots.description: Twice-daily product radar: new launches plus interview breakdowns. Product Hunt and Hacker News first, then X, YouTube, Kickstarter — each item thick enough to decide if it is worth opening.
